message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/curl_fuzzer && python3 - << 'EOF'
import struct
with open('/tmp/testcase_ftp','rb') as f:
    data = f.read()
# Parse TLVs
pos = 0
tlvs = []
while pos + 6 <= len(data):
    t, l = struct.unpack('>HI', data[pos:pos+6])
    pos += 6
    v = data[pos:pos+l]
    pos += l
    tlvs.append((t, l, v))
for t, l, v in tlvs:
    print(f"type={t} len={l}")
    if t == 17:  # RESPONSE1
        # Show first 200 bytes and last 200 bytes
        print(f"  first 200: {v[:200]!r}")
        print(f"  last 200: {v[-200:]!r}")
        # Find newlines
        import re
        nl_positions = [i for i,b in enumerate(v) if b == 0x0a]
        print(f"  num newlines: {len(nl_positions)}")
        print(f"  first 10 newline positions: {nl_positions[:10]}")
        print(f"  last 10 newline positions: {nl_positions[-10:]}")
EOF
